We need to classify relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "O Brasil deve regular os mercados digitais inspirando-se nas experiências internacionais, como a Lei de Mercados Digitais da União Europeia?" This asks whether Brazil should regulate digital markets drawing on international experiences like EU DMA.

Q2: "A legislação de regulamentação do mercado digital deve ser aprimorada?" This asks whether the legislation regulating the digital market should be improved.

Are they same issue? Q1 is about whether Brazil should regulate digital markets inspired by EU DMA. Q2 is about whether the existing legislation should be improved. Could be related but not same. Q1 is about adopting regulation inspired by EU; Q2 is about improving existing regulation. Could be different scope. Also Q2 doesn't specify Brazil, but likely refers to Brazil's legislation. Still, they are different questions: one about adopting new regulation based on EU model; the other about improving existing regulation. Answer to one does not determine the other. So DIFFERENT.
